reviews.review: The game feels dead, in the 3 hours ive played ive gotten to the end of the game already (very quick game) but it feels dead and empty like fallout 76 in its early stages. This game i feel hasnt left early beta stage let alone be able to call it early access. If the game made it more ampend that theres vampires, random "public" events and stuff to do, it could be a good game. At the moment the game doesnt feel like its worth 70€, if you want to play a similar game id reccommend buying dying light, you'll get more fun out of it and the game doesnt seem as dead as this game does (no pun intended) it just feels that the game could be better if the develepors didnt scrown up any and all information on "bad games" and just combined them into one.

reviews.review:
Here is my review:
I got this game bundled with my 4080, so I paid $0.00
I cant add anything more than what has been said, I cant believe how 
a company can release such a ♥♥♥♥♥ show..
I want my money back!! yes I want my ZERO Dollars back.!
Not particularly good. I've played worse. Got some enjoyment. Try to accept the flaws. Advise on sale only. Expect to disagree with my thumbs up.

I enjoyed my time playing it. Not as polished as other Arkane games, though.
Needs an option to play offline.

Definitely not work $70. I would say like $30 at max. I haven't played multiplayer, but don't really have any interest in it. The story is ok so far. The trailer made it seem alot better than it really is. Despite all the negative reviews, I decide to try this game. It's similar to left 4 dead kinda. However I feel like those developers did a better job. Hopefully it will get better. So far the start up is pretty slow. I'm glad I didn't get the Bite Back Edition.
